summary: Master modern marketing principles, GA4 analytics, and customer journey mapping in this 5-day practitioner-led course. Drive ROI and optimize your MarTech stack
lede: Modern marketing uses customer insight, digital channels and creative planning to build coordinated, measurable campaigns. It is designed for marketing professionals responsible for campaigns, brand communication, content or marketing operations who need to plan, coordinate and evaluate marketing activity. Topics include audience segmentation and behavioral personas, SEO and content planning, channel attribution and analytics, marketing automation, and mapping the customer journey.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for executing growth strategies and managing brand presence in a digital-first economy.
audience: Growth Marketing Associates focused on lead generation
modules: Content Strategy and the CMI Framework
Social Media Strategy and Community Engagement
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 1-2 years of experience in a marketing, communications, or sales role. Familiarity with basic digital concepts like social media and web browsing is required. Access to a laptop for hands-on exercises involving Google Analytics 4 and CRM simulations is essential.
